questions.question: Fill in the blank: _____ adds space inside an element.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: padding adds space inside an element, between the content and the border.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: padding adds space inside an element, between the content and the border.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: _____ adds space outside an element.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: margin adds space outside an element, creating distance from other elements.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: margin adds space outside an element, creating distance from other elements.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Use _____ to round corners.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: border-radius creates rounded corners. Higher values = more rounding.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: border-radius creates rounded corners. Higher values = more rounding.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The box model has four layers: content, padding, border, and _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: The four layers are: content, padding, border, and margin (from inside to outside).

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: The four layers are: content, padding, border, and margin (from inside to outside).

questions.question: Fill in the blank: To center an element, use margin: 0 _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: margin: 0 auto; centers a block element by automatically calculating equal left/right margins.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: margin: 0 auto; centers a block element by automatically calculating equal left/right margins.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The _____ property sets element width.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: The width property controls how wide an element is. You can use px, %, em, etc.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: The width property controls how wide an element is. You can use px, %, em, etc.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'border: 2px _____ black;' creates a solid border.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: solid creates a continuous line. Other styles include dashed, dotted, and double.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: solid creates a continuous line. Other styles include dashed, dotted, and double.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Padding is measured in units like _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: Pixels (px) are the most common unit for padding, margin, and borders.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
